## W19 Incident and corrective action record

W19   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: severity is graded on the defect severity scale; containment times are recorded; every action has an effectiveness test; and a named verifier has verified closure with a restart reference where use was paused.

Source basis: [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [AI GRC Copilot](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Copilot)

**Event and affected people or outputs**

Record facts, source evidence, known uncertainty, reporter and protected reporting channel.

**Containment and escalation**

Who pauses/restricts use, preserves records, assesses affected parties and decides required notifications? Record action times.

**Remediation and verified closure**

Identify affected-party remedy, retest evidence, independent verifier, recurrence check and reopening triggers.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Closure decision/date __________  Verifier __________  Restart authorization reference __________

CAPA means corrective and preventive action. Closure needs evidence that the action worked, plus resources and authority to sustain it. Completion of a task alone does not establish effectiveness.
